description: This file is a shell script that performs tests related to Git's handling of binary diffs and applying patches, including testing binary diffs, stat summaries, and error detection in patches.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that might fail without failing the entire test suite.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of all tests.
